title: FDA reverses stance to confirm NMN is lawful for use in dietary supplements
abstract: # FDA reverses stance to confirm NMN is lawful for use in dietary supplements. 3. FDA reverses stance to confirm NMN is lawful for use in dietary supplements The agency’s decision marks a major policy shift, overturning its previous exclusion of NMN and clarifying the ingredient’s place in the supplement market. The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has reversed its position on beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), confirming the ingredient is lawful for use in dietary supplements. The agency has reported a Salmonella outbreak affecting 97 people across 32 US states linked to recalled moringa leaf powder supplements, while also extending its consultation on gluten ingredient disclosure requirements in packaged foods to 22 April 2026.
